# VIRELEO

> VIRELEO is a digital engineering studio that builds custom-coded websites, mobile and web apps, AI workflow automation and AI chatbots (WhatsApp, Instagram and website) for businesses. Work is hand-written, built around the client's workflow, and handed over with readable, documented code.

## Pages
- [Home](/): overview of services, selected work and answers to common questions
- [Work](/work.html): portfolio of live projects and demos, filterable by category
- [Capabilities](/capabilities.html): overview of delivery approach and service capabilities
- [Website development](/website-development.html): business websites, landing pages, portfolios and e-commerce
- [App development](/app-development.html): web apps, mobile experiences, dashboards, portals and MVPs
- [AI automation](/ai-automation.html): connected workflows, lead routing, notifications and information processing
- [AI chatbot development](/ai-chatbots.html): website, WhatsApp and Instagram chatbot experiences
- [About](/about.html): the studio's approach and what to expect when working together
- [Contact](/contact.html): start a project; the enquiry form opens WhatsApp with the message ready to send

## Services
- Website development: business and portfolio sites, e-commerce, landing pages, custom front-end experiences
- Web and mobile applications: dashboards, portals, custom tools and MVPs, API and service integrations
- AI automation: connected AI-assisted workflows that remove repetitive business tasks
- AI chatbots: WhatsApp, Instagram DM and website chatbots for replies, lead capture and bookings
